message:
test(rel-0163 r3): the isolated window-procedure test states the host role it means

With 5729880 a pick pressed before the host's role is known is held, not begun. The isolated test has no host (no
pong): it now checks that hold first (no transaction, nothing sent; a cleared selection drops it), then sets the
role it was always about -- an ordinary host -- for the ack-based clicks that follow (44/44).

Product / test / docs: product (none) / test (window proc isolated) / docs (none).
